phase.method: Ratios of totals across three independent processes per provider/producer; nine windows and 2304 successful operations per route. Stage timings exclude result verification; window allocation/CPU/throughput include it.

short.method: Median/min/max of three cells; all original observations remain in the numeric archive. Cell p99 upper-bound median and pooled histogram p99 are separate. No confidence interval or isolated causal attribution.

resource.method: Three independent fresh processes per provider/version, not interleaved pairs. Scalar workloads differ from DTO phase and mixed load. Forced-GC whole-process retention and lifecycle CPU are descriptive; no native heap or per-window server CPU attribution.

longAtLaunchCheckpoint.archiveStatus: Archive was captured before launch; four long results and two setups remain not_observed in this immutable index.
